# M10 (decision 43, experimental): the R36S models the image ships a DTB
# for, besides the port's own Panel 0 DTB (the default). Wave 1: dArkOSen's
# models (refs/darkosen, MIT; docs/upstream-revisions.txt) on the port's
# board type (rg351mp U-Boot DTB) at 640x480 whose input device names and
# key codes equal the port DTB's (port/scripts/dtb-survey.sh). dArkOSen's
# own Panel 0 DTB is left out: its 29 MHz timing glitches (hardware-findings
# "Bottom-rows glitch"). make-dtb-model.sh adds the port's DT deltas.
#   ID SHA256 DTB   (DTB relative to refs/darkosen/boot/dtb; the folder
#                    name is what the selectors show)
